notes.note: Reviewed the staged home-transfer/activation distinction against the additive route mount and foreground saved-fork guards. A local fork is explicitly refused on a foreign execution target; its context pin or SDK terminal identity is not a home seal, transfer decision, target activation or dispatch grant. No home-authority store/coordinator/participant pairing implementation changes. Existing transfer and cross-host proof gaps remain.

Reviewed interaction continuity, draft preservation, writable continuation and API parity against fork-ready and the context-delivery guard. Handoffs keep the Conversation; explicit forks are separate, and sending stays blocked while continuation is unverified. The late-identity repair permits a proven first completion without introducing a new UI or copying approval state. Current request details remain in Session API; historical captures and mobile claims are not requalified.

Compared the additive mcp-clients namespace and CLI reference update with triage registration/diagnostic ownership. No triage collection/redaction, agent launch, GitHub-search consent or repair authority changes. The new command does not import credentials into triage or make a diagnostic run a repair receipt. Existing local-artifact and provider-sandbox limits remain.

Reviewed broker/connector/Device enrollment and confidentiality boundaries against the two exact external-client administration scope rules. A loopback Station-control lease is not a broker route grant, paired Device, account login or signing-key approval. No broker signaling/enrollment/relay path changes, and no remote/native/public-delivery receipt is added.

Reviewed detection-versus-configuration and secret-handling rules against the orchestration delta. The native identity receipt uses a query binding already created for an explicitly started engine; it does not inspect new credentials, register a detected connection or bypass account setup. Live account/profile eligibility and quota are still separate. Historical provider probes are retained without renewal.

Traced the seed projections and terminal metadata against the retained ledger ownership. New private context facts stay in EventStore; the savepoint isolates derived witness failure from canonical completion. No Adoption/Recovery/TurnDeduplicator transition, credential-application handle, command receipt or broader SessionJournal ownership changes. An engine identity is not proof that a second account credential was applied; live recovery remains unverified.

Compared the exact new access:manage client-administration routes with the inference-serving and contribution scope described here. Selected Conversation/Board tools do not provide inference:invoke, delegate execution or admit fleet candidates. No serving/routing/accounting/receipt-log owner changes. Preserve the chronological implementation record and remote/privacy/cost qualification gaps.

Reviewed the proposal/current-source boundary against the new foreground context port and its typed fresh-conversation fixture. Fork snapshots do not implement station run isolate, create a worktree unconditionally or copy tool/approval state. Existing Project worktree provisioning still owns source pinning and optional baseCommit; no resolver/provisioning code changes. No live engine or release guarantee.

Reviewed MCP Apps metadata, frame/host authority and staged custody limits against runtime-events and the two new route rules. Fork contextDigest and nativeTurnIdentityKey are execution/history facts, not UI resource declarations or a frame grant. The three-tool external-client lease cannot acquire bound browser/UI authority. No MCPService/frame/tool-call implementation or remote-effect-stop guarantee changes.

Reviewed capability-report/permission distinctions and source-owner routes against the additive personal-host issuer. Engine-native identity observation does not change Rust capability enablement, platform adapters, IPC permissions or physical-device delivery. The selected MCP lease is not a native host capability. No native code or support-survey result was changed or requalified.

Reviewed the pilot-gated enrollment and separate Device/account/Project authority introduction against the route-scope delta. The new lease API neither enables the pilot nor replaces install proof, enrollment approval, sealed bearer/ACK, routing custody or account continuation. No relay/enrollment/HPKE/host journal code changes. Existing IPC, Keychain, TURN and physical-person acceptance gaps remain; cryptographic/deployment evidence was not renewed.

Reviewed external-transcript suppression, request-action and delivery-evidence distinctions against the orchestration changes. The new context witness adds no notification method, push audience, activity-card classification or approval action; existing read-only-attached ownership remains authoritative. Engine completion identity is not OS/push delivery. Historical/native provisioning and physical-device receipts retain their dates and limits.

Reviewed its explicitly historical August field/caller inventory against current context module composition and removal of the unused recovery forwarder. These changes do not make the old method counts or proposed cuts current; the module map remains the current interface route. No historical RESOLVED note, extraction evidence or unrelated ownership verdict is rewritten.

Compared the additive Conversation-open/context contract and EventStore projections with the region/pane-host ownership introduction. A saved fork can open without a provider Session, but it does not persist a renderer, native handle, Layout arrangement or control grant. No RegionModel/pane-host/persistence parser implementation changes. Dated gesture, screenshot and device measurements remain historical.

Reviewed identity-versus-membership/execution and primary-resource resolution boundaries against the new fork requester/currentness guards. Server-derived fork ownership and the actual requester remain distinct; a context digest/native identity does not supply Project membership, workspace binding or an execution offer. Compared EventStore changes with this module persistence/authority boundary: context pins and seed witnesses do not alter room proposals, epoch/sequence, checkpoints, permanent idempotency or the L0 core adapter. A correlated provider terminal is not a room membership/signature grant or a home-transfer seal. Reviewed the staged preparation/result-return contract against the changed station-control foreground caller. The added guard refuses moving a known local saved fork to another Station and reads its seed only for the current authorized environment. It does not implement result return, unpublished-work transfer or new remote guarantees; portable attempt claims and receiver preparation are unchanged. No remote-host acceptance.

Reviewed revision identity/attribution and evidence-state distinctions against the EventStore delta. Seed witness hashes concern a Conversation turn, not SharedWorkingState revisions, proposed-change decisions or portable attribution. The new external-client export is unrelated to room-request shapes, and a saved fork cannot silently travel to a peer. No room work journal, independent execution identity, Task current-session association or draft acceptance owner changes. Dated implementation/acceptance statements remain bounded, with no browser, actual-provider or invited-person proof added.
